# JSON string literals, one per line: the literal, a tab, then the UTF-8
# hex of what it decodes to, or `error`. crc's parser (src/json.rs) and
# the extension crate's (crc-extension/src/json.rs in crc-extensions) both
# run these, and both writers must round-trip every decoded value, so the
# text an extension reads cannot differ from what crc sent. crc-extensions
# CI checks its copy against this file.
#
# Not covered: raw control characters inside a string. crc refuses them;
# the crate accepts them. crc's writer never produces one.
""	
"plain text"	706c61696e2074657874
"quote \" backslash \\ slash \/"	71756f74652022206261636b736c617368205c20736c617368202f
"\b\f\n\r\t"	080c0a0d09
"\u0000\u001f"	001f
"caf\u00e9 caf\u00E9"	636166c3a920636166c3a9
"café 漢字 😀"	636166c3a920e6bca2e5ad9720f09f9880
"\u6f22"	e6bca2
"\ud83d\ude00"	f09f9880
"a\uD83D\uDE00b"	61f09f988062
"\ud83d"	error
"\ud83dx"	error
"\ud83dA"	error
"\ude00"	error
"\x"	error
"\u12"	error
"\u12g4"	error
"unterminated	error
